headline: Argentina Drops Criminal Probe Into President Milei Over Memecoin
summary: An Argentine judge dropped a criminal investigation into President Milei, finding that his promotion of the crashed memecoin LIBRA did not constitute fraud.
why: Cryptocurrency promotions by political figures draw intense regulatory and public scrutiny, bridging digital asset market activity and government accountability.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrency
impacts.why: Judicial clearance removes legal liability risks tied to political endorsements of digital tokens.
